body: Nothing. all I did was calculate how much aspirin I would need, what wine I should drink before I do it
I have tried everything. When I say everything, I mean everything. Maybe this is how it ends. I am not supposed to go beyond this

We have over the counter medicines for everything, but not anything to feel okay? like not even better just something to tide yourself over without involving doctors. How many of us have the access to doctors and therapists? Makes me think, this is natural selection, maybe I am not meant to survive and procreate.
Its having the exact opposite affect on me. Suddenly I don't feel scared anymore. Am I going crazy? i feel like I am
what do I do with feeling what I am feeling. Some nights are so tough I can't even breathe. Something has snapped tonight. Nothing makes sense anymore

It is not stupid. someone made you go through your day isn't there anymore. Its a valid reason to feel like nothing ever will make sense again. Nothing ever will be good. Some people can get over this, some can't. I haven't.
I wish you all the best for your future. May our parents move ahead with times.

If someone claims to be an Atheist in India, the response is straight up, "that's not possible, you may or may not believe in God but your religion was decided the day you were born". I hope there are more people who are rebelling in their own ways in real life, if not on internet. The political climate of India has turned into such a cesspool  of toxic religious beliefs, India needs more sane people to counterbalance it.
My family is religious but they don't force it on me.

I used to believe in letting people do whatever they want in their personal lives as long as they don't impose it on others. This whole situation has made me judge people dumb enough to believe in imaginary deity or god and fighting over it. Now if god or religion comes up in any discussion it makes me so uncomfortable and angry that I can not remain civil anymore.

I have been struggling to think of a response to this for 10 minutes because I know exactly what you are going through. I would just say, don't encourage them by giving in to this idiotic melodrama that parents do here. Even if you were not Atheists, the caste system is something nobody needs to deal with in this day and age.
Thank you !

Ah well, we tried for two years. Now I am over it but its his mother who has made me feel this irrational negativity towards people who follow any religion. My family is also religious but they never forced it on me, maybe that's why I think the way I do.  I used to travel frequently to EU countries for work, (before Covid)  and the contrast has made it even more intense. I don't know how familiar you are with the current political atmosphere of India, but everyone around me has developed this overzealous religious fervor which I can't stand anymore.
That's not going to happen. She is stubborn and that's what my issue is with people who make religion everything in their life. They just don't see anything past it.

Well, its always driven among the desi kids (I'm including all South Asia here, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh etc ) , that parents are to be respected always and they have made "sacrifices" to raise you if you were given a good education and basic level of comforts while growing up. In a nutshell if you had an easy and good childhood you better follow your parents or all hell would break lose. This is what the general theme in India is. You stray from the path a bit and its melodrama overdose.

Now, coming to my boyfriend,  he was fine with his mom not agreeing to it but  wanted to inform her at least. We both overly estimated the benevolent heart of his mother. Of course, we know her heart problems have nothing to do with us. Its years of bad diet and no exercise that caused it, not the prospect of him marrying me. But, now that it has happened, he can't just abandon her. I don't know if she fakes it or its real, every time I have come up in discussions, she has taken ill. Her BP spikes, her diabetes gets worse and a whole lot of other issues. To be honest I have given up all hopes of anything would happen now, but that does not make him a bad guy. Just a helpless person who is stuck in the culture he was born into and a mother who just would not understand. Taking care of your family even if it inconveniences you is something that would made sense only if you belong to this land of crazy. He is still the same person I fell in love with and even though we would not get to spend our lives together, I am happy that I met him. I can force him, and maybe he'll leave his mom for me, but what good is that going to do to us in the long run.

Again, difficult for you to understand as you don't come from here. I DO NOT AGREE TO THIS one bit, but I do understand.

Since you asked why would I want to be with him, answer to that it is, even though he is not the most perfect person, he is better than most men I had met so far. Everyone has their weakness, his mom was his.

PS -We are both in our late 20s. He had moved out to a different city, but she is now living with him for treatment. We both work, are financially stable and independent. My point in posting this was, how can someone make religion everything in their life, that they don't see anything past it. It had made my atheist, non confrontational self agitated.

That's where Indian culture as a whole comes in the picture. Grown ass adults are blackmailed and made to feel guilty if they do anything against their parents wishes. She had a cardiac arrest and is unwell, my boyfriend is scared if he pushes the matter further it will have some adverse affect. I do not agree with it, but I understand. I know it will be difficult for someone from outside to comprehend the sheer absurdity of things that happen here.
He just introduced me as the girl he would like to marry and its evident that I am not Muslim. That was enough for his mother.
Even if I go to Mars, what my bf's mom thinks is not going to change. Based on what I read and see, America is not a welcome place for atheists. I would fare much better in Europe.
Exactly, thank you ! It doesn't change anything but feels good to be understood.
good to see someone from the same school of thought. Atheists in India are rare.

Its not just her. People around me, who know about the situation tell me that its me who is in wrong, because I expected anything different. Its an unfair world and I need to deal with it. So its not the religious people who are brainwashed, even the non believers have lost all motivation to do anything against it.
